rule.name: UnguardedCyclicRecursion
rule.message: This method calls itself with a value reached from its parameter through a reference that can lead back (dependencies, references, a cause chain, interfaces), and nothing remembers what it has visited. A cycle ends in a StackOverflowError, and a node shared by two paths (a diamond of interfaces, a shared dependency) is walked once per path, so the cost grows exponentially with depth. Pass a Set of visited values and return when the value is already in it (if (!visited.add(task)) return), or stop at a depth limit.

property.name: xpath

'getDependencies', 'getDependents', 'getDeps', 'getImporters', 'getImports', 'getEdges', 'getLinks', 'getNeighbors', 'getNeighbours', 'getSupertypes', 'getSuperTypes', 'getInterfaces', 'getBases', 'getBaseTypes', 'getSuppressed'), $fields := ('cause', 'causes', 'parents', 'references', 'dependencies', 'dependents', 'deps', 'importers', 'imports', 'edges', 'links', 'neighbors', 'supertypes', 'bases', 'baseTypes'), $step := function($e, $p) { exists($e/descendant-or-self::MethodCall[@MethodName = $getters][*[1][self::VariableAccess[@Name = $p]]] | $e/descendant-or-self::FieldAccess[@Name = $fields][*[1][self::VariableAccess[@Name = $p]]]) }, $reached := function($arg, $p, $m) { let $inner := ($arg/self::CastExpression/*[last()], $arg)[1] return exists($inner/self::MethodCall[@MethodName = 'getCause'][*[1][self::VariableAccess[@Name = $p]]] | $inner/self::FieldAccess[@Name = 'cause'][*[1][self::VariableAccess[@Name = $p]]]) or (some $v in $inner/self::VariableAccess/@Name satisfies exists($m//ForeachStatement[LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name = $v] [$step(*[2], $p)] | $m//LambdaExpression[LambdaParameterList/LambdaParameter/VariableId/@Name = $v] [$step(ancestor::MethodCall[1], $p)] | $m//LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator[VariableId/@Name = $v][$step(*[2], $p)])) }, $treeTypes := ('com.github.javaparser.ast.Node', 'org.w3c.dom.Node', 'com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode', 'com.google.gson.JsonElement', 'java.io.File', 'java.nio.file.Path', 'com.sun.source.tree.Tree', 'javax.lang.model.element.Element', 'org.eclipse.jdt.core.dom.ASTNode') return //MethodDeclaration[Block] [not(.//VariableId[matches(@Name, $guardName, 'i')])] [let $locals := .//LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name return not(.//(VariableAccess | FieldAccess) [matches(@Name, $guardName, 'i') or ((pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Collection') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')) and not(@Name = $locals))])] /(let $m := ., $name := @Name, $arity := count(FormalParameters/FormalParameter) return (for $param in FormalParameters/FormalParameter [not(some $t in $treeTypes satisfies VariableId[pmd-java:typeIs($t)])] return let $p := $param/VariableId/@Name, $index := count($param/preceding-sibling::FormalParameter) + 1 return ($m/Block//MethodCall[@MethodName = $name][ArgumentList/@Size = $arity] [*[1][self::ArgumentList or self::ThisExpression]] [$reached(ArgumentList/*[$index], $p, $m)] [not(ArgumentList/*[$index][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Iterable') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')]) or $param/VariableId[pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Iterable')]])[1])[1])
